scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev --workspace=@trainlead/server" "npm run start --workspace=@trainlead/client -- --host 127.0.0.1"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@trainlead/shared && npm run build --workspace=@trainlead/server && npm run build --workspace=@trainlead/client
scripts.seed: npm run build --workspace=@trainlead/shared && npm run build --workspace=@trainlead/server && npm run seed --workspace=@trainlead/server
scripts.seed:admin: npm run build --workspace=@trainlead/shared && npm run build --workspace=@trainlead/server && npm run seed:admin --workspace=@trainlead/server
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@trainlead/shared && npm run test --workspace=@trainlead/client -- --watch=false && npm run test --workspace=@trainlead/shared && npm run test --workspace=@trainlead/server
